item.title: Yamagata Nature: Dewa Sanzan Sacred Mountains, Zao Crater Lake & Mogami Gorge
item.description: Yamagata Prefecture Nature and Outdoor Guide Yamagata Prefecture, nestled in the Tohoku region of northern Honshu, offers international visitors an extraordinary blend of spiritual mountain pilgrimage, volcanic landscapes, and agricultural beauty that remains largely undiscovered by overseas travelers. From sacred peaks where ancient ascetics trained to snow monsters frozen in Siberian winds, Yamagata delivers some of Japan’s most distinctive outdoor experiences. Dewa Sanzan: The Three Sacred Mountains The Dewa Sanzan—Mt Haguro, Mt Gassan, and Mt Yudono—form the spiritual heart of Yamagata and represent birth, death, and rebirth in the Shugendo mountain religion.
